{{Quote|Oh, I have no illusions about the fact that my escape was a result of the highly sensitive knowledge that I possess: a holodiary cataloging the nefarious deeds of this council.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure, to the Hutt Grand Council|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
A '''holodiary''' was a type of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that was used for information storage. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] contained its criminal dealings on a [[Hutt Council records/Legends|holodiary]] that eventually fell into the possession of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].
